note: Overnight parking in the RV lot at the Columbia Icefield centre on the Icefields Parkway (Hwy 93): a day-use lot that takes RVs and trailers overnight, with views of the Athabasca Glacier. No fires. Separate from the tent-only Icefield campground nearby. --Claude
summary: Keep. Still listed for 2026: open May 13 - Oct 12 (stored mid-May to mid-Oct was approximate), 100 first-come RV/trailer spaces at C$22, no water, no fires.
flags: Season: stored 05-15 / 10-15 'Approximate' -> 05-13 / 10-12 from the Jasper camping page.

Character: Parks Canada describes it as a parking lot ('Used for RV parking during the day, this parking lot becomes an easy place to overnight'); it is an agency-designated, fee-charging overnight area, so reported only, not as a criteria problem.
PIN: no move. Stored 52.21936,-117.22812 falls on the parkway edge about 60 m south of the western parking lots of the Icefield centre (imagery z16). The pages do not say which lot is the RV lot.
PHONE: entry has none; the Jasper pages give only the reservation line, which does not serve a first-come lot.
Toilets: not stated on the page; facilities left without a toilet value.
Agency rows: the entry inherits the US interagency senior/access discount from the generic `federal` row; it does not apply to Parks Canada.
